S1_null_measure_fixed.sql: SELECT g, SUM(v), COUNT(*), MIN(v), MAX(v) FROM t GROUP BY g
S1_null_measure_fixed.notes: ECUBE02 has no measure validity bitmap. With NULL payload stored as 0, COUNT(*) still matches SQL (rows are counted) but MIN and SUM do not: MIN(a) in SQL is 5, the cube returns 0. NULL measures are OUTSIDE the structure; they must be excluded from the cube build or excluded by a range predicate in every query.

S1_null_measure_range_filtered.sql: SELECT g, SUM(v), COUNT(*), MIN(v), MAX(v) FROM t WHERE v BETWEEN 0 AND 100 GROUP BY g
S1_null_measure_range_filtered.notes: When every query ranges over the measure, NULL rows cannot enter the answer, so building from the non-NULL rows is exact.

S2_repeated_having.sql: SELECT g, SUM(v), COUNT(*), MIN(v), MAX(v) FROM t GROUP BY g HAVING SUM(v) >= 500 AND COUNT(*) <= 4
S2_repeated_having.notes: v2 ANDs repeated having=; v1 applied only `count<=4` (both groups pass: SUM(a)=100<500 too).

S3_in_null_name_literal_group.sql: SELECT g, SUM(v), COUNT(*), MIN(v), MAX(v) FROM t WHERE g IN ('NULL') GROUP BY g
S3_in_null_name_literal_group.notes: literal group value 'NULL' exists and is addressable; the SQL NULL group is dropped under any IN/NOT IN by 3VL, so the shared rendered name 'NULL' is not ambiguous for this query shape.

S3_not_in_null_name_literal_group.sql: SELECT g, SUM(v), COUNT(*), MIN(v), MAX(v) FROM t WHERE g NOT IN ('NULL') GROUP BY g

S3_in_null_group_only.sql: SELECT g, SUM(v), COUNT(*), MIN(v), MAX(v) FROM t WHERE g IN ('NULL') GROUP BY g
S3_in_null_group_only.notes: only a SQL NULL group: IN can never match it, cube returns nothing

S6_empty_table.notes: ECUBE02 requires at least one observed value: an empty base table (or a measure column with no non-NULL values) is rejected at build time (ERR empty). Empty *results* under predicates are supported and are covered by the 36-spec empty_result family (36/36 exact).

S10_comma_group_name.notes: where_in/where_not_in are comma-split, so a group value containing ',' cannot be filtered through the CLI. No corpus/fuzz dataset has one.

S11_multiblock_minmax_5_190.notes: contiguous 0..199 = 4 blocks of 64 ranks; v2 MIN/MAX use block-prefix search that must be monotone

S12_u32_count_capacity.notes: ECUBE02 stores u32 per (group,rank) counts and u32 block-count prefixes. All tested pairs have n<=100,000,000 rows; per-cell and per-group counts are therefore < 2^32. The u32 format needs re-checking before a >4.29e9-row-per-group claim.

S13_group_value_rendering.notes: The corpus addresses groups by their rendered SQL value (BIGINT -> decimal string, VARCHAR -> exact bytes). Negative group values (C10: -2..2), values with spaces (C4/C9: 'REG AIR', 'DELIVER IN PERSON'), numeric strings and 3M distinct integers are all exact. FLOAT/DECIMAL/DATE group keys are outside the corpus: the dictionary is built from a str() rendering, so their ordering/formatting would need a pinned canonical form.

S13_empty_result_predicates.notes: 36/36 empty_result family specs are exact (inverted, out-of-domain, IN nonexistent, NOT IN every name, impossible HAVING, unobserved single value).
